title: A guest record with no plan shows no storage card in desktop Settings
evidence: Closed 2026-11-25 (owner ruling): cosmetic: a guest with no plan. The storage card's hasData is plan.planned, or a phone with Settings shown (widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.tsx ~:598), so on a wide screen a guest record with no plan shows no storage card in Settings (PR 1738 note).
